title: Accessible and collaborative moodle-based learning management environment for web users with varying degrees of hearing
reason: System description of an accessible Moodle environment for deaf and hard-of-hearing users with two usability tests (System Usability Scale); no learning-success measure or construct is related to platform data.

extraction.population: deaf and hard-of-hearing test users (adults with low computer literacy; younger users)
extraction.notes: Usability perceptions only. First experiment reported 16 participants.
